state:
**Goal `html-later` — Stage 2 has begun: the decision record is on disk, no behaviour yet.** ADR 0266 (`docs/decisions/0266.md`) decides the whole goal: `later`, the placeholder and token, normal-route assembly, slotted delivery, the polyfill, failure and limits, the closed head, and the after-response trigger. It creates `rule:core-classes/html-later` (status `designed`, empty `guardedBy`) and modifies `rule:concurrency/nothing-is-still-running-when-a-call-returns`, `rule:concurrency/after-response-outlives-the-connection` and `rule:core-classes/html-auto-escape`; each modified text stays true today, since a request with no `later` behaves as before. The module doc of `crates/nvs-runtime/src/deferred.rs` states the new trigger.

The second ADR slot (the polyfill and its CSP hash) is unused and only for Stage 3. `docs/reference/lang/80-concurrency.md:10-13` and `docs/spec/02-php-migration.md:862` are still to be rewritten by the session that lands the behaviour (goal § Stage 0).

items.text: **`Core\Html::later`**: the registry row beside `join`, its task a child of the request started the way `afterResponse` registers (`rule:core-classes/html-later`), the per-request 96-bit token and the placeholder bytes, and the one assembly pass when the frame and every task have ended — `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/html.rs:186`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/task.rs:164`, `crates/nvs-runtime/src/ctx/output.rs:51`.

**The request's limits and the head rule**: every `later` task charged to the request tree with no limit of its own, a limit breach failing the whole request, a throw or own `deadline` filling `error`, and `LogicError` for a head change inside a closure — `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/task.rs:73`, `crates/nvs-runtime/src/deferred.rs:1`.

**After-response work waits for the last `later` task** (ADR 0266 § 10), and `rule:core-classes/html-later` flips to `shipped` with its `guardedBy` filled once the two `.nvst` cases land — `crates/nvs-runtime/src/deferred.rs:1`.

backlog: Stage 3, slotted delivery and the Playwright browser test — goal `html-later` § Stage 3.
Stage 0's two remaining sentences, `docs/reference/lang/80-concurrency.md:10-13` and `docs/spec/02-php-migration.md:862`, with the behaviour — goal § Stage 0.
The calls ADR 0266 § Consequences lists as open to the user's review.
